scoring_justification: Headline quantities (peak wavelengths, beaming angles) are compared to paper-reported values with tolerances; recomputing via full solver is infeasible in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target peak wavelengths (500, 600 nm) and tolerances
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper section III and IV, Fig.2 and Fig.3c
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from the paper's description of the optimized structure and beaming results
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the resonant wavelengths reported in the paper for the asymmetric four-array structure with given parameters

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper section IV, Fig.3c and discussion in section V
hidden_assets.generation_method: The paper states maximum beaming appears at θ=0° for both optimized arrays; in the full demultiplexer, 600nm beam is at 0° and 530nm at 6°, but for the scored setup (500nm+600nm with symmetric output arrays) beaming remains near 0° for both wavelengths
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly from paper's beaming contour plots and description

outputs.description: Normalized transmittance spectrum for the four-array structure. Checked against hidden reference peak positions and peak heights.

schema.description: Three-column CSV: wavelength_nm (float, 500 or 600), angle_deg (float, 0‑90), intensity_I (float).

outputs.description: Far‑field angular distribution at the two resonant wavelengths. Main lobe direction and relative side‑lobe suppression checked against hidden references.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will verify that the transmittance spectrum shows two distinct resonant peaks near the target wavelengths with adequate height, and that the angular distributions exhibit narrow beaming near the expected directions with appropriate lobe suppression. No gold values are disclosed here.
